listItems: Striking varieties: a wide range of vibrant shades and large buds sought after in global markets.

caracteristicas.titulo: From Cayambe soils to global markets
caracteristicas.subtitulo: We make the most of unique equatorial conditions to grow top-quality roses. Our process combines traditional agricultural expertise with precise logistics to anticipate your needs, ensuring absolute freshness and flowers that stand out against any competition. We are direct growers, with daily availability, secure packaging, and personalized support.

carta1.descripcion: High-altitude cultivation: strong stems and large buds under the equatorial sun.

carta2.descripcion: Hand harvesting: strict selection at the exact opening stage.

carta3.descripcion: Global distribution: protective packaging for lasting freshness in international transit.

Caracteristicas_red.subtitulo: We combine natural beauty with export precision. From local florists to international distributors, Lladeal delivers premium roses with long vase life and consistent quality.

lista.descripcion: Whether you're a boutique florist or an international wholesale network, Lladeal adapts to your scale with exclusive varieties and export volumes.
Strict quality control, large buds, and excellent vase life allow our roses to meet the expectations of the most demanding markets.
We help keep deliveries efficient and predictable so roses arrive fresh, hydrated, and ready to impress.
